name: shl-english-practice
description: Practice app for SHL-style spoken and written English tests (MEAN stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
